hero.title: Your motors back in production
hero.description: We rewind, repair and maintain electric motors and industrial equipment. Clear diagnostics, documented testing and lead times you can plan around.
hero.imageAlt: Industrial electric motor opened up in the workshop during a rewinding job

services.title: What we solve
services.description: From rewinding a burnt-out motor to the maintenance plan for your whole plant.

process.title: From diagnosis to delivery
process.description: Five steps with evidence at each one: you know what we found, what we did and how your equipment came out.
process.hint: Keep scrolling to move through the process.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.description: We receive the motor, measure insulation and winding resistance, and document the failure with photos before touching anything.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: You get the scope in writing: what gets replaced, what gets recovered, how much it costs and how many days it takes.

rewinding.title: Rewinding
rewinding.description: We strip the damaged winding, clean the stator and rewind with wire and insulation of the correct thermal class.

testing.title: Testing
testing.description: Varnishing, balancing and electrical tests with no load and under load. You receive the report with every measured value.

delivery.title: Delivery and installation
delivery.description: We hand the motor over ready to run, or install and start it on site, checking operating current and temperature.

why.title: A workshop that answers
why.description: We work with plants that cannot afford long downtime, so we measure, document and respect the agreed dates.

specialists.title: Rewinding specialists
specialists.description: Windings are our core trade, not a side service: three-phase, single-phase and DC motors, plus pumps.

documented.title: Documented testing
documented.description: Every motor leaves with its insulation, resistance and operating current report.

response.title: Emergency response
response.description: We take on unplanned downtime and give you a diagnosis within the first 24 hours.

warranty.title: Written warranty
warranty.description: We back the winding and the labor with a warranty and follow-up after start-up.

cta.title: Do you have a motor out of service?
cta.description: Tell us the nameplate data and the failure you observed. We will come back with a diagnosis and a clear quote.

About.title: The workshop behind your motors
About.description: EMBOTEC was born from the union of technical precision and the energy that moves industry. We are a team dedicated to electric motor rewinding and repair, with industrial maintenance as its natural complement.
About.metaDescription: Meet EMBOTEC: a workshop specialized in electric motor rewinding and repair, with industrial maintenance and documented diagnostics.

story.title: Technical precision and the energy that moves industry

paragraphs.first: We started out servicing motors for local plants that needed a reliable, fast repair. Over time we added industrial maintenance, electrical diagnostics and on-site work, always with the same rule: measure before giving an opinion.
paragraphs.second: Today we service three-phase and single-phase motors, DC motors, pumps and generators across a range of capacities, and we stay with our clients from the diagnosis through start-up on their production line.

measure.title: We measure, we don't guess
measure.description: Every diagnosis starts with insulation and resistance testing, and is documented with photos.

reliability.title: Reliability in every process
reliability.description: We use wire, insulation and varnish of the thermal class the application calls for, with no improvised substitutions.

commitment.title: 360° service
commitment.description: Pickup, repair, testing, delivery and installation: we close the full cycle of the equipment.

continuity.title: Continuity for your plant
continuity.description: We plan the work around your scheduled shutdowns so production keeps running.

Services.title: Rewinding, repair and maintenance
Services.description: We cover the full lifecycle of your electric motors and the equipment around them, in the workshop or on site.
Services.metaDescription: Electric motor rewinding, industrial maintenance, motor and pump repair, and documented electrical diagnostics. In the workshop or on site.

rewinding.title: Electric motor rewinding
rewinding.summary: Full rewind of three-phase, single-phase and DC motors.
rewinding.description: We strip the damaged winding, record the original winding data, clean the stator and rewind with wire and insulation of the correct thermal class. We finish with varnishing and electrical testing before delivery.
rewinding.metaDescription: Rewinding of three-phase, single-phase and DC motors: original winding data, correct insulation class, varnishing and documented testing.

bullets.1: Original winding data recorded before teardown
bullets.2: Magnet wire and class F or H insulation as the application requires
bullets.4: Insulation, resistance and no-load current testing

maintenance.title: Industrial maintenance
maintenance.summary: Preventive and corrective work for motors and plant equipment.
maintenance.description: We design preventive maintenance routines and handle corrective work at your plant: cleaning, bearing replacement, connection checks, alignment and verification of operating parameters.
maintenance.metaDescription: Preventive maintenance routines and corrective work on site: bearings, connections, alignment and verification of operating parameters.

bullets.1: Preventive routines planned around your scheduled shutdowns
bullets.2: Bearing and seal replacement, winding cleaning
bullets.3: Checks on connections, protections and starters
bullets.4: Equipment log with measurements from every visit

repair.title: Motor and pump repair
repair.summary: Bearings, shafts, housings and centrifugal pumps.
repair.description: We repair the mechanical side that goes with the winding: bearings, worn shafts, end covers and housings, plus centrifugal and submersible pumps coupled to the motors we service.
repair.metaDescription: Mechanical repair of motors and pumps: bearings, shafts, covers and housings, rotor balancing and assembly with tolerance checks.

bullets.1: Shaft and housing grinding and metal spraying
bullets.3: Repair of centrifugal and submersible pumps

diagnostics.title: Electrical diagnostics and testing
diagnostics.description: We measure the real condition of your motor before and after servicing it: insulation resistance, winding resistance, current per phase, temperature and vibration, with a report of every value obtained.
diagnostics.metaDescription: Insulation resistance, winding resistance, current per phase, temperature and vibration testing, with a report of every measured value.

bullets.3: Current per phase and imbalance checks
bullets.4: Report with measured values and recommendations
